meaning: 無處不在的、遍布的、充斥著的
example: The pervasive influence of digital communication has fundamentally altered modern human interaction. (數位通訊無處不在的影響，從根本上改變了現代人類的互動方式。)
Rescue workers carefully excavated the concrete rubble following the catastrophic magnitude-7 earthquake. (在災難性的7級大地震後，救援人員仔細挖掘了混凝土瓦礫。)
Severe radioactive contamination rendered the entire industrial zone completely uninhabitable for decades. (嚴重的放射性污染使整個工業區在數十年內完全不適宜居住。)
Farmers must consistently adapt to the unpredictable vagaries of seasonal weather patterns. (農夫必須不斷適應季節性天氣模式變幻莫測的特點。)
The sudden, inexplicable drop in atmospheric pressure puzzled the airport's meteorological team. (大氣壓力突然且無法解釋的下降，讓機場的氣象團隊感到困惑。)
The two corporate boards maintained an antagonistic relationship throughout the hostile takeover negotiations. (在惡性併購談判期間，這兩個公司董事會全程保持著敵對的關係。)
The government introduced strategic tax incentives to catalyze private investments in renewable infrastructure. (政府推出了策略性的稅收激勵措施，以促進民營資本對再生基礎設施的投資。)
Rapid industrial growth merged several neighboring independent municipalities into a sprawling modern conurbation. (快速的工業增長將幾個鄰近的獨立地方政府，合併為一個蔓延的現代大都市圈。)
Industrial wastewater often contains highly corrosive chemical agents that degrade concrete drainage systems. (工業廢水通常含有高度腐蝕性的化學物質，會降解混凝土排水系統。)
The Arctic expedition traversed a completely desolate frozen landscape entirely devoid of vegetation. (北極探險隊橫越了一片完全荒涼、毫無植被的冰封大地。)
The ruling party implemented constitutional changes designed to permanently entrench its political authority. (執政黨實施了旨在永久確立其政治權威的憲法修正。)
The legislative ethics committee conducts rigorous annual audits of every elected public officeholder. (立法倫理委員會每年對每位民選公職人員進行嚴格的審核。)

meaning: 價格高得令人望而生畏地
example: The advanced laboratory medical equipment was prohibitively expensive for small independent research clinics. (這套高階實驗室醫療設備對小型獨立研究診所來說，價格高得令人卻步。)
The administrative board provided a comprehensive scientific rationale for implementing the strict lockdown. (行政委員會為實施嚴格的封鎖措施提供了全面的科學依據。)
The rifle's intense mechanical recoil can surprise novice marksmen during initial target practice. (步槍強烈的機械反作用力，可能會在最初的射擊練習中讓新手射手感到驚訝。)
Certain amphibian species possess the extraordinary biological capability to regenerate entire lost limbs. (某些兩棲類動物擁有非凡的生物學能力，能夠完全再生失去的四肢。)
The environmental protection agency imposed highly restrictive regulations on industrial carbon emissions. (環保主管機關對工業碳排放量祭出了高度限制性的法規。)
Without regular structural capitalization and corporate innovation, small business enterprises can easily stagnate. (在缺乏定期結構性資金注入與公司創新的情況下，小型企業很容易陷入停滯。)
The masterfully engineered architectural dome was supremely stable, enduring multiple structural earthquake tests. (這座工藝精湛的建築圓頂極其穩定，經受住了多次結構性地震測試。)
The physician recommended therapeutic mineral baths to alleviate the patient's chronic muscle inflammation. (醫生建議進行有療效的礦物浴，以緩解患者長期的肌肉發炎。)

meaning: 跡象明顯的、絕對錯不了
example: The distinct fossilized footprints left an unmistakable record of prehistoric predatory dinosaur movement. (這些獨特的化石足跡，為史前肉食性恐龍的移動留下了絕對不會錯的記錄。)
Geologists mapped a massive subterranean river system flowing deep beneath the limestone plateau. (地質學家繪製了一個流經石灰岩高原深處的巨大地下河流系統地圖。)
The advanced electric vehicle accommodates five adult passengers comfortably while maintaining extreme battery efficiency. (這款先進的電動車可在保持極高電池效率的同時，舒適地容納五名成年乘客。)
The historical archive's chief custodian is responsible for preserving delicate documents dating back centuries. (歷史檔案館的首席管理員，負責保存追溯至數個世紀前的脆弱文獻。)

meaning: 宗教派別、紙鈔面額面值
example: The historic museum contains banknotes of every legal denomination printed during the civil conflict. (這家歷史博物館收藏了內戰衝突期間印刷的每一種法定面額之紙鈔。)
The newly updated server infrastructure functioned dependably throughout the high-traffic global retail event. (新更新的伺服器基礎設施，在整個高流量的全球零售活動中皆可靠地運作。)
Computer graphics artists utilize specialized programming tools to render complex three-dimensional topographical models. (電腦圖形藝術家利用專業的程式設計工具，來渲染複雜的三維地形模型。)
The architectural monument was distinctively designed, combining raw structural concrete with delicate geometric glass. (這座建築紀念碑的設計非常獨特，將原始的結構混凝土與精緻的幾何玻璃結合在一起。)
Medical researchers are ethically obligated to obtain informed consent from every active human participant. (醫學研究人員在道德上，有義務獲得每位積極參與的人類受試者之知情同意。)

meaning: 群居的、社交的、愛交際的
example: Wolves are highly gregarious animals that rely on structured pack dynamics to hunt successfully. (狼是高度群居的動物，依賴有結構的狼群互動來成功狩獵。)

meaning: 人文主義者、人文主義的
example: The Renaissance scholar advanced a humanist curriculum that prioritized classical literature, history, and ethics. (文藝復興時期的學者提出了一門人文主義課程，將古典文學、歷史和倫理學列為優先。)
The porous specialized clay structures can rapidly imbibe fluid compounds from the surrounding environment. (這種多孔的專用黏土結構，能夠迅速吸收周圍環境中的液體化合物。)
Wood-boring termites can easily infest wooden houses if protective coatings are neglected. (如果忽略防護塗料，蛀木的白蟻很容易大量侵入木造房屋。)

meaning: 不可彎曲、僵化缺乏彈性
example: The corporation's inflexible management policies prevented it from adapting to the shifting consumer demands. (該公司僵化缺乏彈性的管理政策，阻礙了其適應不斷變化的消費者需求。)
The historical museum contains several early nineteenth-century prints produced via advanced stone lithography. (這座歷史博物館藏有數幅透過先進石版印刷術製作的19世紀早期印刷品。)
The whistleblower detailed the loathsome working conditions that factory laborers were forced to endure. (吹哨者詳細描述了工廠勞工被迫忍受的令人厭惡之工作環境。)
The biological nervous system functions to modulate sensory inputs based on surrounding light levels. (生物神經系統的功能是根據周圍的光線水平來調整感官輸入。)
The traditional tribal performance relied on dynamic, percussive rhythms produced by handmade wooden drums. (傳統的部落表演依賴手工木鼓所產生的動態敲擊節奏。)
Earth's magnetic polarity has undergone multiple complete reversals over the course of geological history. (在地質歷史的進程中，地球的磁極性經歷了多次完全倒轉。)
The elderly professor tended to ramble during lectures, occasionally deviating from the scheduled syllabus. (這位年邁的教授在講課時往往會東拉西扯，偶爾偏離了既定的教學大綱。)
Without proper state monetary controls, rampant inflation can rapidly destabilize a developing nation's economy. (在沒有適當國家貨幣控制的情況下，猖獗的通貨膨脹會迅速使開發中國家的經濟不穩定。)
The expanding retail conglomerate ruthlessly undercut local businesses to secure an absolute market monopoly. (這家不斷擴張的零售集團無情地壓低價格以削弱當地企業，從而確保絕對的市場壟斷。)
Media critics condemned the news channel for prioritizing tabloid sensationalism over objective investigative reporting. (媒體評論家譴責該新聞頻道將小報的煽情主義置於客觀的調查報導之上。)
The prominent clinical surgeon maintained a successful commercial sideline as a medical textbook author. (這位傑出的臨床外科醫生保持著一個成功的商業副業——擔任醫學教科書作者。)
The executive report succinctly summarized the complex financial merger within a single comprehensive brief. (該主管報告在一份全面的簡報中，簡潔地概述了這起複雜的財務合併案。)
The tropical depression brought torrential rain that caused catastrophic flash flooding along coastal rivers. (熱帶低氣壓帶來了傾瀉的暴雨，導致沿海河流沿線發生災難性的山洪暴發。)
Tectonic plate movements cause gradual structural deformation of the Earth's crust over geological eras. (板塊運動在地質年代中，導致了地球地殼逐漸發生的結構變形。)
Genetic testing allows modern individuals to trace their deep geographic ancestry back thousands of years. (基因檢測讓現代人能夠將其深厚的地理血統追溯到幾千年前。)
The tropical plant species possesses highly aromatic leaves used in the production of organic perfumes. (這種熱帶植物擁有高度芳香的葉子，可用於生產有機香水。)
Laboratory technicians conduct daily calibration of the sensitive mass spectrometers to ensure precise scientific measurements. (實驗室技術員每天對敏感的質譜儀進行校準，以確保精確的科學測量。)
The diplomat warned against forming any strategic military alliance that could lead to geopolitical entanglement. (外交官警告不要建立任何可能導致地緣政治糾纏的策略性軍事聯盟。)
The international trade agreement focused entirely on the technological facilitation of cross-border customs processing. (該國際貿易協定完全聚焦於跨國海關處理在技術上的便利化。)
The decades-long political feud between the two prominent families severely destabilized the municipal government. (這兩個著名家族之間長達數十年的政治世仇，嚴重動搖了地方政府的穩定。)
The early diplomatic skirmishes over trade barriers served to foreshadow the full-scale geopolitical conflict. (早期圍繞貿易壁壘的外交小衝突，預示了全面地緣政治衝突的到來。)
The central bank introduced sudden interest rate hikes to forestall a potential real estate bubble. (中央銀行突然實施升息措施，以預先阻止潛在的房地產泡沫化。)
Astrophysicists study cosmic microwave background radiation to understand the exact genesis of the early universe. (天體物理學家研究宇宙微波背景輻射，以了解早期宇宙確切的起源。)
The university dean was widely celebrated for his genial demeanor and accessibility to undergraduate students. (該大學院長因其和藹親切的舉止以及對大學生的平易近人而廣受讚譽。)
The structural engineer verified that the heavy concrete mixture contained precise levels of mineral grit. (結構工程師驗證了厚重的混凝土混合物中含有精確水平的礦物砂礫。)
The complex aerial gyration performed by the acrobatic jet team required split-second flight synchronization. (特技噴射機隊所進行的複雜空中旋轉，需要精確到分秒的飛行同步。)
The aerospace engineering team developed a lightweight aluminum honeycomb structure to reinforce the aircraft's wings. (航空太空工程團隊研發了一種輕量化的鋁製蜂巢狀結構，以加固飛機的機翼。)

meaning: 無法克服的、難以逾越的
example: The deep ocean trench presented what initially seemed like insurmountable technical obstacles for exploration teams. (深邃的海溝最初對探測隊來說，呈現出看似無法克服的技術障礙。)
The ecosystem's survival is intimately linked to the preservation of its primary apex predator populations. (該生態系統的生存，與其主要頂級捕食者族群的保護密切地相關。)
The dynamic character in the play expressed a deep longing for freedom and social autonomy. (劇中充滿活力的角色表達了對自由和社會自主權的深切渴望。)
The indigenous elders held an extensive knowledge of botanical lore, utilizing wild herbs for medicine. (原住民長老掌握了豐富的植物學傳統知識，利用野生草藥來治病。)
The historic city's unique cultural landscape is a vibrant melange of indigenous and colonial architecture. (這座歷史城市的獨特文化景觀，是原住民與殖民時期建築的一種充滿活力的混合物。)
Critics argued that the play relied excessively on theatrical melodrama rather than authentic character development. (評論家認為這部戲劇過於依賴誇大的舞台通俗劇，而非真實的角色發展。)
There is a common public misconception that all bacteria are harmful pathogens, ignoring beneficial microbes. (大眾普遍存在一個錯誤觀念，認為所有細菌都是有害的病原體，而忽略了有益的微生物。)
The modernist artist painted a stunning monochromatic mural utilizing various shades of deep cobalt blue. (這位現代主義藝術家利用不同深淺的鈷藍色，繪製了一幅令人驚嘆的單色壁畫。)
In ancient mythologies, the sky deity was frequently depicted as an omnipotent ruler overseeing humanity. (在古代神話中，天空之神經常被描繪成掌控全人類的全能統治者。)
The arctic hunters carefully preserved the thick bear pelt to provide insulation against subzero temperatures. (北極獵人仔細保存了厚重的熊毛皮，以提供抵禦零下溫度的絕緣保護。)
The textbook serves as an excellent primer for students entering the field of evolutionary biology. (這本教科書對於進入演化生物學領域的學生來說，是一本極佳的入門書。)
The young computer scientist achieved international prominence after developing an innovative open-source cybersecurity protocol. (這位年輕的電腦科學家在開發了一款創新的開源網路安全協定後，獲得了國際著名的地位。)
The massive volcano remained quiescent for over three centuries before suddenly erupting with explosive force. (這座巨大的火山在突然以爆炸性力量噴發之前，曾保持沉寂休眠了三個多世紀。)
The corrupt executive demonstrated no scruples whatsoever when embezzling millions from the corporate pension fund. (這名貪腐的高階主管侵吞公司退休基金數百萬美元時，毫無良心上的顧忌。)
The international medical agency moved to standardize chemical testing protocols to ensure global vaccine safety. (國際醫療機構採取行動使化學測試協定標準化，以確保全球疫苗的安全。)
The newly discovered deep-sea marine organism was strikingly different from any previously classified species. (這種新發現的深海海洋生物，與任何先前分類的物種皆顯著地不同。)
Human rights organizations actively campaign against the exploitation of textile labor within any industrial sweatshop. (人權組織積極發起反對在任何工業血汗工廠內剝削紡織勞工的運動。)

meaning: 棋盤格嵌鑲、棋盤狀圖案
example: Architects utilized a stunning geometric tessellation of marble tiles to decorate the central cathedral floor. (建築師利用大理石瓷磚構成的精美幾何棋盤格嵌鑲，來裝飾中央大教堂的地板。)
Specialized winter tires are engineered to maintain maximum traction on icy and snow-covered roadways. (專用的冬季輪胎經過精心設計，能在結冰與被雪覆蓋的道路上保持最大的摩擦牽引力。)
The sudden cancellation of the international flight unavoidably disrupted the schedule of the diplomatic summit. (國際航班的突然取消，無可避免地打亂了外交峰會的行程。)
The ideological dispute created an unbridgeable divide between the two political factions during constitutional drafting. (在起草憲法的過程中，意識形態的爭議在兩個政治派別之間造成了無法跨越的鴻溝。)
Epidemiologists documented a sudden upsurge in seasonal influenza cases during the unusually cold winter months. (流行病學家記錄了在異常寒冷的冬月期間，季節性流感病例的突然急劇上升。)
Biochemists analyze snake venom to discover active compounds that can be utilized in cardiovascular medications. (生物化學家分析蛇毒，以發現可用於心血管藥物的活性化合物。)
The prominent planetary scientists discovered clear geological evidence of ancient, large-scale volcanism on Mars. (著名的行星科學家在火星上發現了古代大規模火山活動的明確地質證據。)
The local public university received a massive multi-million dollar bequest from a prominent former graduate. (當地公立大學收到了由一位傑出前畢業生所提供的一筆高達數百萬美元的巨額遺贈。)
Corporate complacence following years of market monopoly left the tech giant completely vulnerable to innovative startups. (多年市場壟斷帶來的公司自滿，讓這家科技巨頭在面對創新新創公司時完全不堪一擊。)
The ancient monument was covered in cryptic inscriptions that historical linguists have struggled to fully decipher. (這座古代紀念碑上佈滿了神秘隱晦的銘文，歷史語言學家一直難以完全破譯。)
The sheer magnitude of the global climate crisis did not daunt the determined young environmental researchers. (全球氣候危機的龐大規模，並未使意志堅定的年輕環境研究人員感到氣餒。)
The elite athletic club hosted an international equestrian competition that featured world-class show jumping events. (這家菁英體育俱樂部舉辦了一場國際馬術比賽，以世界級的障礙超越賽為特色。)
The United Nations framework aims to ensure an equitable distribution of global environmental resources among nations. (聯合國框架旨在確保全球環境資源在各國之間得到公平的分配。)
The anthropological research team conducted a rigorous, multi-year ethnographic study of the remote Amazonian community. (人類學研究團隊對偏遠的亞馬遜社區進行了一項嚴謹且為期多年的民族誌研究。)
The sudden economic crisis served to galvanize the legislative assembly into passing the structural banking reforms. (突然爆發的經濟危機，成功激勵了立法議會通過結構性的銀行改革方案。)
During the historical heyday of transatlantic steam travel, thousands of grand vessels crossed the ocean weekly. (在跨大西洋蒸汽航行歷史上的全盛時期，每週有數千艘宏偉的船隻橫渡海洋。)
A horde of tourists descended upon the historic ruins as soon as the summer gates opened. (夏天的景點大門一開，一大群遊客便蜂擁而至這座歷史遺跡。)
Despite receiving the prestigious international accolade, the lead scientist maintained a posture of profound professional humility. (儘管榮獲了享譽國際的知名榮譽，這位首席科學家仍保持著極具專業素養的謙遜姿態。)
The clinic detected the disease in its incipient stage, allowing for highly effective early medical treatment. (診所偵測到了該疾病的初期階段，從而能進行高度有效的早期醫療。)
The glaring incongruity between the politician's lavish lifestyle and his public rhetoric alienated working-class voters. (該政治人物奢侈的生活方式與其大眾言論之間明顯的不協調，疏遠了勞工階層選民。)
The rare migratory avian species visits the northern wetland preserve only infrequently during major solar events. (這種珍稀的遷徙鳥類只有在大規模太陽活動期間，才會罕見地拜訪北方濕地保護區。)
The indigenous artifact was intricately carved from jade, displaying delicate patterns that represented local mythic narratives. (這件原住民文物是由玉石錯綜複雜地雕刻而成，展示了代表當地神話敘事的精細圖案。)
The student newspaper's satire was marked by a sharp irreverence toward the university's traditional administrative hierarchy. (學生報紙的諷刺文章以對大學傳統行政體制的尖銳不敬為特色。)
The structural integrity of the high-rise skyscraper was engineered to withstand immense lateral wind forces. (這棟高層摩天大樓的結構完整性，經過工程設計能承受巨大的橫向風力。)

meaning: 特立獨行、不服管教的人
example: The tech entrepreneur was widely regarded as a corporate maverick who consistently rejected traditional industry models. (這位科技創業家被廣泛視為公司中特立獨行的人，他一貫拒絕傳統的產業模式。)
The continuous urban layout spanning from Boston to Washington D.C. forms a massive Eastern megalopolis. (從波士頓延伸到華盛頓特區的連續城市佈局，形成了一個巨大的東部特大城市群。)
Certain non-venomous insect species display mimetic patterns that replicate the color warnings of deadly wasps. (某些無毒的昆蟲物種展示出模仿擬態的花紋，複製了致命黃蜂的顏色警告。)
The elderly author's memoir offered a nostalgic reflection on rural life during the pre-industrial era. (這位年邁作家的自傳對工業化之前的農村生活進行了懷舊的反思。)
The intense geothermal conditions functioned over millions of years to petrify the buried ancient forest timber. (強烈的地熱條件在數百萬年裡發揮作用，使埋藏的古代森林木材石化。)
The historic industrial city maintained an economic predominance in steel manufacturing throughout the late twentieth century. (在整個20世紀後期，這座歷史悠久的工業城市在鋼鐵製造業中保持著經濟上的主導地位。)
Aerospace engineers designed the cabin to pressurize automatically as the experimental aircraft ascended beyond the clouds. (航空太空工程師將機艙設計為隨著實驗飛機升入雲端而自動加壓。)

Most meteoroids are fragments of asteroids or comets that vaporize when they enter Earth's atmosphere. (大多數流星體是小行星或彗星的碎片，進入地球大氣層時就會汽化。)
Spruces at the timberline have thick, needlelike leaves that help them resist dry air. (林木線上的雲杉有厚實的針狀葉，能幫助它們抵抗乾燥的空氣。)
Geologists survey the subglacial channels where meltwater flows beneath polar ice sheets. (地質學家調查極地冰層下方融水流動的冰下河道。)
Farmers in subtropical regions once relied heavily on starchy taro tubers for food. (亞熱帶地區的農民曾高度依賴富含澱粉的芋頭塊莖為食。)
The walls of the limestone cave were covered with varicolored crystals. (石灰岩洞穴的牆面覆滿五顏六色的結晶。)
The homesteader consulted an almanac to predict when the rainy season would begin. (這位拓荒農場主人查閱曆書，預測雨季何時開始。)

meaning: 美國歷史文物/民俗珍玩總稱
example: The museum curator compiled a comprehensive collection of nineteenth-century Americana, including Conestoga wagons and rawhide tools. (博物館館長彙編了一批詳盡的十九世紀美國歷史文物收藏，內含科內斯托加式大篷車與生牛皮工具。)
The spread of farm homesteads across the Midwest came to symbolize nineteenth-century capitalism and a distinctly American individualism. (農場宅地在中西部的擴張，後來象徵了十九世紀的資本主義與獨特的美國個人主義。)
Polynesian navigators crossed thousands of isolated islands in the Pacific archipelago. (玻里尼西亞航海家橫越太平洋群島中數千座孤立的島嶼。)
The centralization of state administration sped up the bureaucratization of the tax system that governed trade. (國家行政的中央集權，加速了管理貿易的稅務體系官僚化。)
The guild council passed a bylaw requiring every craftsperson to register a personal tool mark. (公會理事會通過一條內部章程，要求每位工匠登記個人的工具刻記。)
Ancient Egyptian art followed the strict rules of classicism, favoring frontal poses and balanced symmetry. (古埃及藝術遵循嚴格的古典主義規則，偏好正面姿態與對稱平衡。)
Anomalies in Earth's magnetic field can cause severe disorientation in migrating birds. (地球磁場的異常，可能讓候鳥嚴重迷失方向。)
The Bronze Age metalworker doused the hot copper in water to speed up cooling. (青銅時代的金屬工匠把高溫的銅浸入水中，加速冷卻。)
The silent film screening featured a live piano and flute duet. (那場默片放映搭配了鋼琴與長笛的現場二重奏。)
Weavers extracted natural dyestuffs from plants to dye raw wool a vivid magenta. (織工從植物中提取天然染料，把原色羊毛染成鮮豔的洋紅色。)

meaning: 單粒小麥（最早被馴化的野生小麥一種）
example: Neolithic farmers domesticated wild einkorn by selecting plants whose seeds stayed attached to the stem. (新石器時代的農民挑選種子緊附在莖上的植株，馴化了野生單粒小麥。)
Terminal moraines mark the endpoint of a glacier's farthest advance. (終磧標記了冰河推進最遠的終點。)

meaning: 極漫長的時間；宙（地質最大時間單位）
example: The Proterozoic eon lasted nearly two billion years and saw the rise of multicellular life. (元古宙持續將近二十億年，期間出現了多細胞生物。)

meaning: 極端；末端；手足（四肢末端）
example: Polar seals limit blood flow to the extremities of their flippers to conserve heat. (極地海豹限制流向前肢末端的血流，以保住熱量。)
Genetic evidence confirms that the theropod dinosaur was the ancient forebear of modern birds. (基因證據證實，獸腳類恐龍是現代鳥類的古老祖先。)
Late Victorian shopping arcades were lit by rows of gaslit lamps. (維多利亞時代晚期的購物拱廊，由一排排煤氣燈照明。)

meaning: 僧侶的；（古埃及）僧侶體文字的
example: Ancient Egyptian scribes developed a stylized hieratic script system to streamline royal archive records beside formal hieroglyphs. (古埃及書吏發展出了一種風格化的僧侶體文字的書寫系統，以在正式的象形文字旁簡化皇家檔案記錄。)
Thomas Cole was a leading American landscapist and a founder of the Hudson River School. (湯姆·柯爾是美國重要的風景畫家，也是哈德遜河派的創始人之一。)
The chieftain ordered workers to dig a deep moat around the stone fortress. (首領下令工人繞著石造堡壘挖一條深護城河。)
The outrigger canoe allowed early seafarers to travel vast distances across the ocean. (舷外浮桿獨木舟讓早期航海家得以橫越廣闊的海洋。)
The nineteenth-century printer used a second plate to overprint dark red details onto the page. (十九世紀的印刷工使用第二塊版，在頁面上套印深紅色細節。)
Plant pathology examines the causes and effects of disease in plants. (植物病理學研究植物疾病的成因與影響。)
Sociologists studied how the spread of the home perm changed Victorian ideas of beauty. (社會學家研究家用燙髮的普及如何改變維多利亞時代的審美觀。)
The botanist measured water loss from the leaf blades and petioles of the plant. (植物學家測量這種植物葉片與葉柄的水分散失。)
Slow changes in Earth's planetary orbit help explain the regular return of ice ages. (地球行星軌道的緩慢變化，有助於解釋冰河期規律重現。)

meaning: 高壓電線塔；高塔門（埃及廟宇結構）
example: The temple entrance was framed by a massive stone pylon carved with reliefs. (神廟入口由一座巨大的石造塔門構成，上面刻有浮雕。)
The railhead grew into a busy market town where ranchers brought cattle for shipment east. (鐵路終點站發展成熱鬧的市集城鎮，牧場主把牛隻送來以便運往東部。)
The silent-film theater hired a piano soloist to accompany the screen action live. (那家默片戲院請了一位鋼琴獨奏者，現場為銀幕上的情節伴奏。)

meaning: 向南的；南方的；來自南方的
example: A southerly wind carried warm, moist air into the valleys. (一股南風把溫暖潮濕的空氣帶進山谷。)
The biographer traced letters written by a prominent Southerner who ran a ranch and fenced off large tracts of prairie. (傳記作者追查一位知名南方人寫的信；此人經營牧場，並在大草原上圍起大片土地。)
The Whig leader hired a speechwriter to draft his speeches on infrastructure spending. (這位輝格黨領袖雇用演講稿撰寫人，替他起草基礎建設支出的演講稿。)
Volcanic particles that reach the stratosphere can block sunlight around the world. (進入平流層的火山微粒，可能阻擋全球的陽光。)
Plains tribes lived in portable tepees made of rawhide stretched over wooden poles. (平原部落住在可攜帶的圓錐帳篷裡，帳篷是用撐在木桿上的生牛皮搭成的。)
Engineers installed horizontal iron tiebacks to reinforce the old masonry wall. (工程師安裝水平的鐵製拉桿，加固老舊的石造牆體。)
Lichens gain a toehold in tiny cracks in granite and slowly break the rock down. (地衣在花崗岩的細小裂縫中取得立足點，慢慢分解岩石。)
The shaman's verbalizable rules were carefully recorded on clay tablets. (薩滿能以言語表達的規範，被仔細記錄在泥板上。)
Engineers drove horizontal cedar waling along the roadbed to hold the marshy ground in place. (工程師沿路基施作雪松水平板樁條，固定沼澤地層。)
A sudden winter deluge sent a flash flood sweeping across the lowlands. (一場突如其來的冬季暴雨，讓洪水瞬間淹過低地。)
Strong winds can fray the needles and twigs of trees at the timberline. (強風會磨損林木線樹木的針葉與細枝。)
Anaerobic microbes in waterlogged fen soil break down plant matter without oxygen. (積水沼澤土中的厭氧微生物，在沒有氧氣的情況下分解植物殘體。)
Under the electron microscope, the grain looked no bigger than a mote of dust. (在電子顯微鏡下，那粒砂子看起來不比一顆灰塵大。)
Geographers mapping nineteenth-century hospitals cataloged mass-produced ceramic bedpans. (繪製十九世紀醫院分布圖的地理學家，記錄了大量生產的陶瓷便盆。)

meaning: 凝結；濃縮（動詞第三人稱單數）
example: When warm air from the whale's lungs meets cold air, the moisture condenses into a visible spout. (鯨魚肺部的暖空氣遇上冷空氣時，水氣凝結成看得見的噴水柱。)
The black spruce is a hardy coniferous tree that marks the northern edge of the timberline. (黑雲杉是一種耐寒的針葉樹，標示出林木線的北界。)
The city council drafted a bill to electrify all of the city's tram lines. (市議會起草法案，要讓全市的路面電車路線全面電氣化。)
Retreating glaciers carved deep valleys along the coast, creating a rugged fiord landscape. (後退的冰河在海岸切出深谷，形成崎嶇的峽灣地形。)
A huge Arctic ice floe drifted south into the shipping lanes, pushed by polar winds. (一大片北極浮冰在極地氣流推動下，向南漂進航道。)
The theater hired a harper to play live music during the performance. (那家劇院請了一位豎琴師，在演出時現場演奏。)
The artisan added ground manganese to the glaze to give the pot a brilliant blue-green hue. (工匠在釉料中加入磨碎的錳，讓陶罐呈現鮮豔的藍綠色調。)
Artisans extracted indigo dye from plants to create a deep blue glaze for earthenware pots. (工匠從植物提取靛藍染料，製作深藍色釉料，用來裝飾陶罐。)
Nineteenth-century printmakers used intaglio methods to cut fine detail into copper plates. (十九世紀的版畫家使用凹版方法，在銅板上刻出精細的細節。)
A minor structural kink inside the vascular xylem conduit can provoke a severe gas embolism, stopping water conductance. (維管束木質部導管內部一個微小的結構扭結，會引發嚴重的氣體栓塞，阻斷水分導度。)

meaning: 壤土（含有砂、粉砂與黏土的肥沃土壤）
example: The fertile breadbasket plain has deep loam soils well suited to growing corn. (這片肥沃的穀倉平原擁有深厚的壤土，非常適合種玉米。)
The seller used an iron mesh sieve to sort grain by size before selling it. (賣方用鐵絲網篩把穀物按大小分級，然後才出售。)
Mathematicians define a monoid as a set with an associative operation and an identity element. (數學家把單位半群定義為具有結合運算與單位元素的集合。)
Bronze Age metalworkers brought copper ore to a local smelter to produce ingots. (青銅時代的金屬工匠把銅礦石送到當地熔煉廠，煉成金屬錠。)
Early vaudeville acts combined cornet music with a hand-shaken tambourine to create lively rhythms. (早期的綜藝表演把短號音樂與手搖鈴鼓結合，營造熱鬧的節奏。)
Ancestral Pueblo villages often had compact, boxlike rooms arranged in a triangular layout. (祖先普韋布洛人的村落常有緊湊的箱形房間，排列成三角形布局。)
The singer added a warm vibrato that gave the Broadway orchestra a richer sound. (這位歌手加上溫暖的顫音，讓百老匯管弦樂團的音色更豐富。)
Early silent-film theaters used small orchestras that mixed brass and woodwind instruments. (早期的默片戲院使用小編制管弦樂團，結合銅管與木管樂器。)
The ancient Maya deliberately built a ritual platform beside a deep freshwater cenote. (古代馬雅人刻意在一個深淡水天然井旁搭建儀式平台。)
The geological formation of sandstone bedrocks requires the long-term compaction and coalescence of granular quartz sand grains. (砂岩基岩的地質形成，需要顆粒狀石英砂粒長期的壓實與接合。)
The parasitic mite crawls into the sepals of flower buds, where it causes tissue damage. (這種寄生蟎會爬進花蕾的萼片，造成組織損傷。)
Gas-filled bladders keep colonies of single-celled marine algae afloat near the sunlit surface. (充滿氣體的氣囊讓單細胞海藻群體漂浮在受光照的表層附近。)
The master cabinetmaker hired a young immigrant as a helper to clean up wood scraps in the shop. (這位細木工匠師傅雇用一名年輕移民當助手，清理工作坊裡的木屑。)
Chemical analysis showed that the seeds of the taro plant are rich in oily compounds. (化學分析顯示，芋頭的種子富含油脂成分。)
A leak in the hull caused a serious spillage of oil that soaked the cargo of raw flax. (船體裂縫造成大量漏油，浸濕了亞麻原料貨物。)
Ancient Mediterranean artisans used thin sheets of gold leaf to gild the stone facade of the palace. (古代地中海的工匠用薄金箔為宮殿的石造正面鍍金。)
Post-glacial river meltwater streams deposited highly fertile layers of alluvial silt across the lowland basin. (冰河期後，河流融水在低地盆地沉積了深厚肥沃的沖積粉砂層。)
The ichthyosaur had a large, stiff dorsal fin that helped stabilize it in the water. (魚龍有一個大型堅硬的背鰭，幫助牠在水中保持穩定。)
Acidic groundwater erosion completely hollowed out the limestone bedrock layer, generating a spectacular subterranean grotto network. (酸性地下水侵蝕石灰岩基岩層，逐漸掏空岩石，形成壯觀的地下洞穴群。)

meaning: 阿爾法 (第一個字母/首要的/領頭的)
example: The alpha wolf howled across the valley to coordinate the pack's defense against intruders. (領頭狼隔著山谷嚎叫，協調狼群防禦入侵者。)
Ancestral Pueblo villagers built multi-story stone kivas deep inside sandstone alcoves. (祖先普韋布洛人在砂岩壁龕深處建造多層的石造儀式建築。)
Astronomers expect the Andromeda galaxy to merge with our own Milky Way in several billion years. (天文學家預期仙女座星系會在數十億年後與我們的銀河系合併。)
The Ashcan School painters turned away from polished academic subjects and painted gritty scenes of city life. (垃圾箱畫派的畫家揚棄學院派精緻題材，改畫粗礪的城市生活場景。)

meaning: 地圖集；（解剖）寰椎（第一頸椎）
example: The historical geographer cross-referenced an archaic colonial atlas to chart preindustrial turnpike transit networks. (歷史地理學家對照一本古老的殖民地地圖集，繪製工業化前的收費公路網。)
The stone walls were built to deter attackers from the border. (這些石牆是為了嚇阻來自邊界的攻擊者而建。)
In the nineteenth century, travelers carried a compact Baedeker to find their way around Mediterranean ports. (十九世紀的旅人會帶一本精簡的貝德克爾指南，在地中海各港口間找路。)
The rancher wore a cotton bandanna over his face to keep the prairie dust out. (這位牧場主人用棉質方巾遮住口鼻，擋住草原的塵土。)
As polar temperatures rise, a coastal glacier may calve a huge berg into the sea. (隨著極地氣溫上升，沿海冰河可能崩解出一座巨大的冰山落入海中。)

meaning: 雙足的；用兩條腿走路的
example: The evolutionary transition to a bipedal walking stance freed early hominid forelimbs to manipulate manual tool blanks. (向雙足步行姿勢的演化過渡，釋放了早期原始人類的前肢以操縱手工工具胚料。)

meaning: 矽晶柱（半導體單晶錠）；古希臘議會
example: In semiconductor manufacturing, a large silicon boule is sliced into thin wafers that become microchips. (在半導體製造中，大型矽晶柱會被切成薄晶圓，再製成微晶片。)
Paleolithic craftspeople utilized a flint burin to incise intricate geometric motifs and inscriptions into cedar slabs. (舊石器時代的手工藝人利用燧石雕刻刀，在雪松木板上雕刻出複雜的幾何圖案與銘文。)

meaning: 頭；首要部分 (解剖學常用)
example: Paleoanthropologists study the hominid caput to track the evolution of a larger brain. (古人類學家研究原始人類的頭部，追蹤腦容量變大的演化。)

meaning: 教義問答；核心問答手冊
example: Literate clergy in medieval schools used a Latin catechism to teach students the basics of the faith. (中世紀學校裡識字的神職人員用拉丁文教義問答，教導學生信仰的基本道理。)
Cognitive psychologists believe the cerebral cortex controls complex language abilities in primates. (認知心理學家認為，大腦皮質掌管靈長類複雜的語言能力。)
Stiff rawhide ropes can chafe and warp delicate cedar planks unless they are lubricated. (僵硬的生牛皮繩會磨損、扭彎精細的雪松木板，除非先上潤滑油。)
Primitive chondritic meteorites preserve chemical traces of the solar nebula from which the planets formed. (原始球粒隕石保存了行星形成時太陽星雲的化學痕跡。)
Under extreme tectonic stress, brittle sandstone layers fracture cleanly along vertical faults. (在極大的板塊應力下，脆性的砂岩層會沿著垂直斷層俐落地斷裂。)

meaning: 油菜類植物；科爾 (人名例：湯姆·科爾)
example: Thomas Cole founded the Hudson River School, specializing in naturalistic paintings that captured wild American wilderness expanses. (湯姆·柯爾創立了哈德遜河派，專門描繪美國荒野的自然景觀。)
Excess phosphorus in runoff can contaminate rivers and trigger massive algal blooms. (逕流中的磷過量會污染河川，並引發大規模藻華。)

meaning: 皮革製革匠；（人名例：柯里爾）
example: The Currier print workshop produced popular lithographs of farm life in the Midwest. (柯里爾版畫工坊製作了一批受歡迎的石版畫，描繪中西部的農場生活。)
A geographer mapping nineteenth-century taverns cataloged the iron cuspidors found in them. (一位地理學家在繪製十九世紀酒館分布圖時，記錄了店裡的鐵製痰盂。)
The post-glacial meltwater streams carved out a lush, fertile dale highly suited for early Neolithic sedentary settlements. (冰河期後的融水溪流雕琢出了一個翠綠肥沃的山谷，非常適合早期新石器時代的定居點。)
An igneous dike forms when liquid magma forces its path into vertical crustal fractures, solidifying underground. (當液態岩漿強行進入垂直的地殼裂縫並在地底凝固時，就會形成火成岩牆。)
The ancestral pueblo craftspeople constructed semi-subterranean kivas featuring sturdy, domelike timber roofs. (祖傳普埃布洛手工藝人建造了半地下的儀式建築，其特徵是具有結實、穹頂狀的木製屋頂。)

meaning: 杜氏 (常指真實笑容 Duchenne smile)；杜氏肌營養不良症
example: Psychologists can identify a genuine Duchenne smile by the contraction of muscles around the eyes. (心理學家能藉由眼周肌肉的收縮，辨認出真正的杜氏笑容。)

meaning: 類（門得列夫預測未知元素的字首，如類鋁）
example: Mendeleev utilized the prefix 'eka' to predict the chemical parameters of undiscovered elements like gallium before their physical extraction. (門得列夫利用字首「類」來預測未發現元素（如鎵）在實際提取出來之前的化學參數。)
Franklin conducted rudimentary electro-static experiments, tracking how charged atmospheric particles interact during high-velocity storms. (富蘭克林進行了基礎的靜電實驗，追蹤帶電的大氣粒子在高速暴風雨中如何互動。)

meaning: 書信（尤指正式或重要書信）
example: The historical biographer cross-referenced each personal epistle drafted by Abigail Adams during the American Revolution. (歷史傳記作者交叉比對了艾比蓋爾·亞當斯在美國革命期間所起草的每一封個人書信。)

meaning: 不穩定的；古怪的；（地質）漂礫（冰河帶來的巨石）
example: An erratic is a massive granite boulder transported miles away from its native bedrock by a moving glacier. (冰河漂礫是一塊由移動冰河從其原生基岩運送到數英里外的巨大花崗岩巨石。)

meaning: （器物上的）裝飾盾牌；銘牌；紋章盾
example: Archaeologists found a Bronze Age blade whose metal escutcheon was decorated with etched bands. (考古學家找到一把青銅時代的刀刃，上面的金屬裝飾牌飾有蝕刻條紋。)

meaning: 面部拉皮手術；（建築）翻新

The low-lying fen wetland experiences continuous waterlogging, supporting anaerobic bacteria that decompose plant peat layers. (地勢低窪的低地沼澤濕地經歷持續的積水，支持著分解植物泥炭層的厭氧細菌。)
The pterosaur was an agile flier that could glide over the ocean on its long wings. (翼龍是敏捷的飛行生物，能靠長翼在海上滑翔。)
In horses and other quadrupeds, the foreleg carries much of the body's weight. (在馬等四足動物身上，前肢承受了身體大半的重量。)
Dissections of the primate skeleton show how the bones of the knee joint meet at the genu. (靈長類骨骼的解剖顯示膝關節的骨頭如何在膝部相接。)

meaning: 石膏底料（用於繪畫基底）

meaning: 大的；格蘭德 (如 Rio Grande 里奧格蘭德河)

An active bird, as a homeotherm, must keep a high metabolic rate to stay warm in the Arctic. (活躍的鳥類是恆溫動物，必須維持高代謝率才能在北極保暖。)
The terminal moraine layer forms a distinct horizontal gravel hump across the eroded river valley mouth landscape. (終冰磧層在受侵蝕的河谷口景觀跨度間，形成了一個獨特的水平碎石圓凸構造。)

The Art Deco urban metropolis skyscrapers featured streamlined architectural ironwork and bold geometric motifs. (裝飾藝術風格的城市摩天大樓，以流線型的鐵作與大膽的幾何圖樣為特色。)
The bird's skeleton has a large keel that anchors the powerful flight muscles. (鳥類骨骼有大型龍骨突，用來附著強而有力的飛行肌肉。)

meaning: 戴菊鳥（一種微小型鳥類）；小國王

meaning: 敲擊（燧石等以製作石器）
example: A skilled Paleolithic artisan could knap a rough stone slab into a symmetrical scraper. (熟練的舊石器時代工匠能把粗糙的石片敲打成對稱的刮削器。)

meaning: （書稿等）空白；漏字；（生物）空隙/腔洞
example: The damaged tablet left a major lacuna in the cuneiform archive. (這塊泥板破損嚴重，在楔形文字檔案中留下了一大段空白。)

meaning: 鱈魚的一種；石南屬植物
example: Marine zoologists analyzed the migratory tracks of the coastal ling schools navigating deep estuarine tidal channels. (海洋動物學家分析了在深層河口潮汐通道中行進的沿海鱈魚群的遷徙軌跡。)

The geographer studied early merchant ledgers to track trade recorded in Italian lira. (這位地理學家研究早期的商人帳冊，追蹤以義大利里拉記錄的貿易。)
The flat plains of the Midwest are covered with thick, fertile loess deposited by wind after the ice age. (中西部平坦的平原覆蓋著厚實肥沃的黃土，是冰河期後由風吹積而成。)

The wealthy merchant decorated his parlor with a carved cedar mantel. (這位富商以雕刻的雪松壁爐架裝飾客廳。)
Tectonic compression along active boundary zones pushed the plutonic granite strata upward, forming a massive mountain massif. (活躍邊界帶沿線的板塊壓縮將深成花崗岩地層向上推升，形成了一個巨大的山區地塊。)
Advanced electron microscopy allows biochemists to analyze the pristine atomic structure of eukaryotic cell membranes. (先進的電子顯微鏡讓生物化學家能分析真核細胞膜完整的原子結構。)

meaning: 單塊巨石的；大一統的；僵化的

meaning: 麻醉；昏迷（常與氮因高壓引起連用）

The geologist took samples of crystalline basalt from a nearby rock outcrop. (地質學家從附近的岩石露頭採集結晶玄武岩樣本。)

Archaeologists use aerial photogrammetry to map the layout of Ancestral Pueblo earthworks. (考古學家利用航空攝影測量，繪製祖先普韋布洛人土方工程的布局。)
The early photographer used a simple pinhole camera to take black-and-white pictures of landmarks. (早期的攝影師用簡單的針孔相機拍攝地標的黑白照片。)
The historical geographer noted that the flat-bottomed pram was utilized to ferry commodities across shallow river lowlands. (歷史地理學家指出，這種平底小船曾被用來在淺淺的河流低地間運送商品。)
A quasar is an extremely bright object powered by a massive black hole at the center of a galaxy. (類星體是極明亮的天體，由星系中心的超大質量黑洞提供能量。)

meaning: （鳥類的）羽毛筆；大羽毛；豪豬刺

meaning: 耙子；傾斜度；（用耙子）耙平

Greenhouse gases trap heat in the atmosphere, and the planet reradiates some of it toward the surface. (溫室氣體把熱困在大氣中，行星再把部分熱能輻射回地表。)

The stream eroded the riverbed, exposing layers of gravel and boulders. (溪流侵蝕河床，露出礫石與巨石的層次。)

meaning: 動物糞便（用於生態追蹤）

Biochemists isolated secretin, a hormone released by the small intestine that helps regulate digestion. (生物化學家分離出促胰液素，這是小腸分泌、有助調節消化的荷爾蒙。)
Ancestral Pueblo people built semi-subterranean kivas with a precise semicircular stone wall. (祖先普韋布洛人建造半地下的儀式建築，牆體是精確的半圓形石造結構。)

meaning: 船隻失事；海難化石沉積

meaning: 強烈味道；刀柄柄腳（嵌入刀柄的部分）

meaning: 第凡內 (人名/藝術玻璃風格例：路易斯·蒂芙尼)

The moth features a colorful geometric underwing pattern that is hidden during rest but flashed abruptly to disrupt predatory birds. (這種蛾以色彩斑斕的幾何後翅圖案為特色，在休息時會隱藏，但會突然閃現以干擾捕食性鳥類。)
The modern choreographer integrated the traditional steps of the Viennese valse into an abstract theatrical routine. (這位現代編舞家將維也納圓舞曲的傳統舞步，融入到一個抽象的劇場常規表演中。)

meaning: 脈管；導管（常與 deferens 連用）

Anaerobic bacteria in the herbivore's viscera break down complex plant starches. (食草動物內臟中的厭氧細菌會分解複雜的植物澱粉。)

meaning: 具洞察力的；有深刻見解的

meaning: 道地的；符合語言習慣的

Linguists analyze ancient cuneiform text scripts characters to prove if abstract symbols are distantly linked with physical referents. (語言學家分析古代楔形文字文字符號，以證明抽象符號是否與物理指示物有著遙遠地（疏遠地）聯繫。)
The mercantile harbor authority deployed mechanical barges to dredge loose organic silt fragments from the navigable river waterfront. (商業港口當局部署了機械駁船，以從可通航的河流濱水區疏浚（開挖）鬆散的有機粉砂碎片。)
The ancient maritime empire built monumental stone citadels to honor the legal coronation decrees of their ruling empress. (古代沿海海洋帝國建造了不朽的石造城堡，以紀念其執政女皇的合法加冕法令。)
Persistent over-extraction of groundwater will invariably engender severe land subsidence and structural cracking. (持續超抽地下水，必然引發嚴重的地層下陷與結構龜裂。)
Within hierarchical military chiefdoms, common laborers were treated as expendable asset assets deployed to build monument fortification structures. (在階級化的軍事酋邦內部，普通勞工被視為可犧牲的（消耗性的）資產，被部署去建造宏偉的防禦工事構造。)
Itinerant vaudeville performers wore flashy homespun suspender outfits to draw crowds in the arcades. (巡迴的雜耍藝人穿著俗麗的手織棉吊帶裝，在大都市拱廊街吸引人潮。)
The discovery of a pristine organic text tablet inside a waterlogged crevice was a highly fortuitous archaeological event. (在積水裂縫內部發現一塊具原始狀態的有機文字泥板，是一次非常幸運的（偶然的）考古事件。)
Two distinct predator finches can achieve a stable harmonious coexistence if they exploit separate canopy understory seed niches. (如果兩種不同的捕食性雀鳥能利用不同的樹冠林下植物層種子生態棲位，牠們就能實現穩定的和諧共存。)
Linguists decoded the detailed cuneiform-like hieroglyph markings engraved directly into the flat stone facade of the monument. (語言學家解密了直接雕刻在紀念碑平坦石造正面上的詳細的、類似楔形文字的象形文字（象形符號）標記。)
Compacted snow structures compose block layers that function as an exceptional thermal insulator inside the traditional Inuit igloo. (緊實的雪結構組成的塊層，在傳統的因紐特雪屋內部充當優異的絕熱體（絕緣體）。)
Rapid urbanization inside the factory metropolis converted rural families into landless wage earners locked into piecework factory slots. (工廠大都市內部的快速城市化，將農村家庭轉化為被鎖定在計件工作工廠職位中的無土地的工資賺取者。)
The structural looseness of the loose granular topsoil strata made fields highly vulnerable to intense wind erosion anomalies. (鬆散顆粒狀表土層結構的鬆散性，使得田地極易受到強烈風力侵蝕異常現象的傷害。)

meaning: 具延展性的；可塑的；易受影響的
example: Copper is a highly malleable metal, allowing Bronze Age metalworkers to forge ornate chalices easily. (銅是延展性極高的金屬，讓青銅時代的工匠能輕易鍛造華麗的聖杯。)
Seasonal rain will slowly moisten the arid topsoil, prompting dormant seeds to sprout. (季節性降雨會慢慢濕潤乾旱的表土，促使休眠的種子發芽。)
Enduring the severe winter cold inside overcrowded urban factory tenement quarters was exceptionally stressful for immigrant laborers families. (在擁擠的城市工廠廉租公寓宿舍區內忍受嚴酷的冬季寒冷，對移民勞工家庭來說是壓力極其沉重的。)
The private turnpike company erected a heavy wooden tollgate block across the intercity roadbed to collect transit fees. (私營收費公路公司在城市間的路基跨度上豎立了一個沉重的木製收費閘門（收費站），以徵收通行費。)
Archaeologists had to meticulously untie the organic rawhide bands binding the ancient bone tines to the tool handle. (考古學家必須細心地解開（釋放）將古代骨製尖齒固定在工具手柄上的有機生牛皮帶。)
The naturalistic Greek statues were visually spectacular, capturing fluid human movement with perfect anatomical logic. (寫實的希臘雕像在視覺上極為壯觀，以精準的解剖邏輯捕捉流暢的人體動態。)
A sudden shift in soil conductance is discernible in the strata immediately after a catastrophic meteorite impact. (毀滅性隕石撞擊後，地層中的土壤導度會出現明顯的突然變化。)
The artistic motifs carved onto the limestone slab show sinuous vine lines that entwine symmetrically around the deity. (雕刻在石灰岩厚板上的藝術主題，展現出圍繞神明對稱交織（糾纏）的蜿蜒藤蔓線。)

meaning: 偶發的；片段的；由多個事件組成的
example: Climatologists map how post-glacial rain drops recharges follow an episodic rather than constant continuous annual trend matrix. (氣候學家繪製了冰河期後降雨補給如何遵循一種偶發的（片段的）而非持續連續的年度趨勢基質。)
The vascular conduits of angiosperm plant stems are composed of stable, elongated fibrous cells that conduct fluids efficiently. (被子植物植物莖的維管束導管，由能有效導導流體的穩定的、延伸的纖維質的（纖維的）細胞組成。)
The high thermal fluidity of subsurface molten magma dictates the eruption velocity of active basaltic volcanic fault lines. (地表下熔融岩漿的高熱流動性（流體特徵），主導了活躍玄武岩火山斷層線的爆發速度。)
The primitive atmospheric formation of Earth was driven by volcanic outgassing streams spewing volatile compounds from the mantle. (地球原始大氣的形成是由火山排氣（氣體噴出）流所驅動的，岩漿從地函中噴出揮發性化合物。)
The volcanic island arc formations were created successively as tectonic plates drifted over an active subsurface mantle hotspot. (火山島弧構造是隨著地殼板塊在活躍的地表下地函熱點上漂移而接續地（接連著地）被創造出來的。)
Heavy post-glacial meltwater flash flood runoff can transform loose alluvial silt sediment basins into toxic quicksand traps. (由冰河期後融水突發洪水引發的沉重的逕流，能將鬆散的沖積粉砂沉積盆地轉化為危險的流沙陷阱。)
Early aerodynamic scientists analyzed the wing profile of the prehistoric pterosaur and modeled it as an agile glider. (早期空氣動力學家分析史前翼龍的翅膀剖面，把牠模擬成靈活的滑翔生物。)
The geometric band lines incised into the earthenware pot show sinuous vine figures that intertwine symmetrically around the facade. (雕刻在土罐上的幾何條帶線，展現出圍繞正面對稱交織（糾纏）的蜿蜒藤蔓圖案。)

meaning: 首位；卓越；核心主導地位
example: The continuous primacy of strict frontality rules across ancient Egyptian art reflected deep-seated spiritual frameworks regarding the afterlife. (嚴格正面性規則在古埃及藝術中的持續核心主導地位（首位），反映了關於來世根深蒂固的精神框架。)
The exceptional structural preservation of pristine organic insect parts trapped inside cedar resin amber stands as a scientific rarity. (困在雪松樹脂琥珀內部的原始有機昆蟲部分的優異結構保存，堪稱一項科學上的罕見之物（稀有）。)
A shifting coastal sandbar acts as a natural dynamic filtration barrier, isolating the river estuary from open ocean currents. (移動的沿海沙洲充當了一個天然的動態過濾屏障，將河流河口與開闊的海洋洋流隔離。)

meaning: 填料；（小碎布/紙等的）一團
example: The expert toolmaker inserted a thick wad of organic flax fibers to wedge the obsidian shield firmly into arrows. (專家級工具製造者插入了一厚團（填料）有機亞麻纖維，以將黑曜石防護製品堅固地卡入箭矢中。)

meaning: 被風吹颳的；暴露在風中的
example: The rugged upland plains are windswept deserts, where high-speed polar winds prevent large woody forests from growing. (崎嶇的高地平原是受風吹襲的荒漠，高速極地氣流讓大型森林無法生長。)
Cretaceous mass extinction events altered climate indicators globally, wiping out terrestrial dinosaur populations. (白堊紀的大規模滅絕事件改變了全球氣候指標，消滅了陸地恐龍族群。)
Uranus is an outer gas giant planet orbiting deep inside the cold frozen margins of our solar cosmos grid. (天王星是一顆外層氣體巨行星，在我們太陽宇宙網格寒冷冰凍的邊緣深處內部運行。)
The survey geologist tracked the deep fault rift zones whence molten liquid basalt magma escaped onto oceanic seabed crusts. (調查地質學家追蹤了深層斷層裂谷帶，熔融的液態玄武岩岩漿由此（從何處）逸出到海洋海床地殼上。)
The figural stone relief art on the classical facade depicted an elite aristocrat draped in a carved broadleaf flower garland. (古典建築正面上的具象石雕浮雕藝術，描繪了一位身披雕刻闊葉花環的精英貴族。)
The sudden post-glacial post-glacial thaw thermal warming event sequence caused a concurrent elevation in river delta runoffs runoff. (突然的冰河期後融化熱量變暖事件序列，引發了河流三角洲逕流量同時發生的（並發的）攀升。)

meaning: 依情況地；依附帶情節地
example: Before the craters were unearthed, circumstantial evidence only tentatively supported the theory linking asteroid impacts with Cretaceous extinctions. (在隕石坑被發現之前，只有間接證據暫時支持小行星撞擊與白堊紀滅絕相關的理論。)
Geothermal energy conversion infrastructures harvest mantle heat spikes to manufacture clean industrial electricity units for the metropolis. (地熱能轉換基礎設施收穫地函熱量高峰，以製造（生產）供大都市使用的乾淨工業電力。)
The widespread ecological dominance of angiosperms began during the late Cretaceous period. (被子植物廣泛的生態主導地位始於白堊紀晚期。)
Angiosperms diversified prolifically during the late Cretaceous epoch, supplanting gymnosperms across equatorial biomes. (被子植物在白堊紀晚期時代多產地（豐富地）多樣化，跨越赤道生物群系取代了裸子植物。)
Each stratum of sedimentary rock represents a specific period in Earth's geological history. (沉積岩的每一地層都代表了地球地質歷史上的一個特定時期。)

meaning: 身體上；物理上；在物理層面
example: Tectonic stresses physically deform sedimentary strata, crumpling uniform bedrock layers into mountainous ridges. (這種材料在物理層面上具有明顯差異。)
The dramatic evolutionary diversification of Cretaceous angiosperms began to overshadow older gymnosperm canopy trees. (白堊紀被子植物劇烈的演化多樣化，開始使更古老的裸子植物樹冠樹木顯得遜色。)
Angiosperms expanded rapidly during the late Cretaceous period, beginning to supplant dominant gymnosperm groups. (被子植物在白堊紀晚期迅速擴張，開始取代佔主導地位的裸子植物群。)
Nineteenth-century physicists hypothesized that a weightless substance called ether filled the interstellar cosmos. (十九世紀的物理學家假設，一種稱為乙醚的無重量物質充斥在星際宇宙中。)
Physiologists study how prolonged weightlessness inside interstellar cosmos chambers deforms mammalian skeletal bone densities. (生理學家研究星際宇宙艙內長期的無重量狀態（失重），如何使哺乳動物的骨骼骨頭密度變形。)
A paleoecologist extracts fossilized pollen grains from sedimentary strata to reconstruct prehistoric rainforest biomes. (一位古生態學家從沉積地層中提取花粉化石顆粒，以重建史前的雨林生物群系。)
Sedimentary strata are conventionally interpreted with the oldest layers resting at the absolute bottom. (沉積地層在傳統上被解讀為最古老的層位留在最底部。)
Each individual volcanic eruption leaves a chemically identifiable ash layer inside nearby sedimentary strata. (每次單獨的火山爆發，都會在附近的沉積地層內留下化學上可識別的火山灰層。)
Because sedimentary layers accumulate sequentially, older fossils must logically rest beneath freshly deposited strata. (由於沉積層是按順序累積的，因此更古老的化石在邏輯上必須留在新鮮沉積的地層下方。)
Porous sedimentary rocks like sandstone are ideal for containing fluids like groundwater and petroleum. (像砂岩這樣多孔的沉積岩，非常適合容納地下水和石油等流體。)
Bituminous coal is a dense carboniferous sedimentary rock extensively utilized for industrial electricity generation. (煙煤（瀝青煤）是一種密集的含碳沉積岩，廣泛用於工業發電。)
Limestone is a sedimentary rock composed primarily of calcium carbonate from marine skeletal fragments. (石灰岩是一種主要由海洋生物骨骼碎片中的碳酸鈣組成的沉積岩。)
Acidic groundwater slowly hollowed out the limestone rock, generating a massive subterranean cavern network. (酸性地下水緩慢地掏空了石灰岩岩石，產生了一個巨大的地下大溶洞網路。)
A falling atmospheric raindrop is naturally acidic, carrying hydrogen ions that dissolve limestone calcite bedrocks. (落下的大氣雨滴天然呈微酸性，攜帶能溶解石灰岩方解石基岩的氫離子。)
The tundra is a cold, treeless biome characterized by permafrost and brief summer growing seasons. (凍原是一個寒冷、無樹的生物群系，以永凍土和短暫的夏季生長季為特徵。)
The hydrodynamic adaptations of the marine ichthyosaur minimized water resistance, enhancing its predatory swiftness. (魚龍的流體力學適應把水的阻力降到最低，提升了牠捕食時的速度。)
Sedimentary rocks often contain well-preserved fossils that allow scientists to chart ancient environmental changes. (沉積岩通常含有保存完好的化石，讓科學家能夠繪製古代環境變遷的圖表。)
Paleontologists discovered a well-preserved megafossil of a prehistoric tree trunk in the sedimentary layer. (古生物學家在沉積層中發現了一塊保存完好的史前樹幹巨體化石。)
Advanced optical filters in modern planetariums provide a clearer visual tracking grid of stellar movements. (現代天文館中先進的光學濾鏡，提供了更清晰的恆星運動視覺追蹤網格。)
The calcite mineral dissolution inside limestone caverns turns subterranean puddles into a murky, milky fluid. (石灰岩溶洞內下方解石礦物的溶解，使地底的水窪變成了混濁的乳白色流體。)
The irregular shoreline of the fjord was shaped by tectonic activity and successive glacial movements. (該峽灣不規則的海岸線是由地殼活動和接連的冰河運動所塑造的。)
Earth's lithosphere forms the outermost rigid layer of the planet, fracturing into expanding tectonic plates. (地球的岩石圈構成了該行星最外層的僵硬地殼層，分裂成擴張中的板塊。)
The river delta terminates inside a flat, marshy wetland where anaerobic bacteria decompose organic sediment layers. (河流三角洲終止於一片平坦、沼澤的濕地中，此處厭氧細菌分解了有機沉積層。)

meaning: 無庸置疑地；毫無疑問地
example: The global radiation dominance of angiosperms across Cretaceous biomes stands unquestionably as a critical evolutionary breakthrough. (被子植物跨越白堊紀生物群系的全球輻射主導地位，無庸置疑地堪稱一項關鍵的演化突破。)
Modern digital planetariums introduce interactive tracking displays that allow dwellers to model stellar cosmos expansion lines. (現代數位天文館引入了互動的追蹤顯示，容許居民模擬恆星宇宙的擴張線。)
Estuarine mudflats act as vital tidal wetlands, capturing rich organic silt sediment layers that feed shorebirds. (河口泥灘扮演著至關重要的潮汐濕地角色，捕捉供養岸鳥的豐富有機粉砂沉積層。)
When threatened, the marine invertebrate will swiftly retract its sensitive tentacles inside its protective limestone skeleton. (當受到威脅時，這隻海洋無脊椎動物會迅速將其敏感的觸手縮回其保護性的石灰岩骨骼內部。)
Geologists study how the chemical cementation of sediment particles under high pressure forms solid sedimentary rock. (地質學家研究在高壓下沉積物顆粒的化學膠結作用是如何形成堅固的沉積岩。)
Sedimentary rock formation requires the continuous compaction of loose mud and clay layers under deep water. (沉積岩的形成需要深水下鬆散的泥土和黏土層持續受到壓實作用。)
Intense crustal compression at plate borders causes horizontal sedimentary layers to deform and crumple into mountains. (板塊邊界強烈的地殼壓縮，導致水平的沉積層發生變形並崩潰褶皺成山脈。)
Luckily, the fragile leaf imprint was preserved unaltered inside a protective fine-grained sedimentary shale layer. (幸運地，這片脆弱的葉片印記被原封不動地保存在一個保護性的細顆粒沉積頁岩層內部。)
The archaeologist meticulously documented the depth of each sedimentary layer within the excavated fault line site. (考古學家細心地記錄了挖掘出的斷層線遺址內，每個沉積層的深度。)
The newly built planetarium utilizes a digital projector system to display realistic simulations of stellar movements. (新建造的天文館利用數位投影機系統來展示恆星運動的寫實模擬。)
The subterranean limestone cavern network featured a sinuous passageway carved out by centuries of acidic groundwater. (地下石灰岩大溶洞網路以一條蜿蜒的通道為特色，是由數個世紀的酸性地下水沖刷雕琢而成的。)
The massive preponderance of specialized angiosperm plants inside modern equatorial zones began during late Cretaceous adaptive radiations. (現代赤道區域內部特化被子植物壓倒性的數量（優勢），始於白堊紀晚期的適應性輻射擴張。)
Astronomers overlay a precise digital tracking grid onto planetarium projectors to measure planetary trajectories across the cosmos. (天文學家將一個精確的數位追蹤網格疊加到天文館放映機上，以測量跨越宇宙的行星軌道。)
The extreme rapidity of the Cretaceous boundary mass extinction suggested an exogenous shock like an asteroid collision. (白堊紀邊界大規模滅絕極端的迅速（速度），暗示了像小行星撞擊這樣的外源性衝擊。)
The trace inclusions of volatile sulfate molecules were found diffusely distributed inside the sedimentary page rock matrix. (揮發性硫酸鹽分子的痕量內含物，被發現擴散地（稀疏地）分佈在沉積頁岩礦物基質內部。)

meaning: 異質的；由不同成分組成的
example: Sedimentary rock till layers deposited by retreating glaciers are highly heterogeneous, mixing huge boulders with fine sand. (由後退冰河沉積的冰磧沉積岩層是高度異質的，將巨大的巨石與細砂混合在一起。)
The fine-grained sedimentary shale bedrocks split lengthwise smoothly, exposing leaf imprints trapped millions of years ago. (木料沿著長度方向裂開。)
The lithosphere forms the rigid, uppermost structural layer of the planet, fracturing into active tectonic drifting grids. (岩石圈構成了該行星僵硬、最上面的結構層，分裂成活躍的地殼構造漂移網格。)
The tundra biome is aptly termed a frozen treeless desert, where permafrost constants exclude large woody roots entirely. (凍原生物群系被適當地（巧妙地）稱為冰凍無樹沙漠，那裡的永凍土常數完全排除了大型木本根部。)
Unlike calcite minerals which dissolve in carbonic rain runoff, silicate quartz granules remain largely insoluble inside sandstone bedrocks. (與溶解在碳酸雨水逕流中的方解石礦物不同，矽酸鹽石英微粒在砂岩基岩內部很大程度上保持不溶。)
The thinness of the mineral clay particle is measured in microns, dictating the overall porosity of sedimentary shale. (礦物黏土顆粒的薄度是以微米來計算的，主導了沉積頁岩的整體孔隙率。)
Shale is a fine-grained sedimentary rock formed from the compaction of silt and clay-size mineral particles. (頁岩是一種細顆粒的沉積岩，由粉砂和黏土大小的礦物顆粒壓縮而成。)
The Arctic tundra is a cold, treeless biome where tall woody plants cannot penetrate the dense subterranean permafrost. (北極凍原是一個寒冷、無樹的生物群系，高大的木本植物無法穿透緻密的地下永凍土。)
The extreme lateness of the Cretaceous mass extinction phase is documented via fossil deviations in terminal sedimentary rock layers. (白堊紀大規模滅絕階段的極度晚期狀態，透過末端沉積岩層中的化石分支得到了記錄。)
The government made concessions to appease the protestors. (政府做出讓步以平息抗議者。)
Advanced calculus is required for most engineering degrees. (大多數工程學位都需要修讀高等微積分。)
Sociologists study deviant behavior to understand societal norms. (社會學家研究越軌行為以了解社會規範。)
The system analysis relies on advanced dynamical models. (該系統分析依賴進階的動態模型。)
The conquerors attempted to enslave the indigenous population. (征服者企圖奴役當地的原住民。)
